丸子粉瞬间爆发，碾压那些准备看时笙笑话的。

看看，人家就算不加V那也是牛逼哄哄的，我们家小丸子的金主，那必须就是这个样子。

方立秋V：金主大人求包养！//@江晚：金主大人晚安@陆清韵

苏宜修V：金主大人求发工资//@江晚：金主大人晚安@陆清韵

这两条转发，瞬间又激起千层浪。

方立秋的粉丝也是很庞大的，自家女神竟然在微博上光明正大的求包养，女神虽然你有点跳脱，但是请你矜持好吗？

还有那个苏宜修，那不是有间娱乐的BOSS吗？他还求发工资，那不是说这是BOSS的BOSS？天啦噜，这个世界怎么了。

那个陆清韵是谁，快来个人科普啊！！

一些人倒是想科普，可是完全查不到，就这么一个名字，一个模糊的侧面，连个电话都没有，怎么查？

就算能查到，也不是一时半会能查出来的。

于是有人就开始说话了，觉得这是自导自演，那些关注列表，肯定都是刷的。

这个说法一出，就有人反驳，你刷一个全是大V的关注列表出来！

大战一触即发，偏偏陆清韵那边没有丝毫动静，有的技术宅查出了那个账号的最后登陆时间，正是发布唯一一条微博的时间，之后就再也没登陆过。

众人傻眼了。

说好的金主呢？

就这么没了？

时笙这边闹哄哄的，夏萱那边也没消停，因为之前那个工作室说了未完待续，不少人都等着后面的料。

就在时笙的微博发出后不久，工作室也更新了。

这次更新的内容就比较特别了，是一张合照，照片中的人是一群青春靓丽的大学生，背景是国内的一所大学，夏萱站在中间，看上去俏皮可爱很有活力。

这看上去就是一张普通的合照，没有任何不对劲的地方。

Chapter 44 The financial owner is hiding behind me (24) - "The villain BOSS is poisonous"

Meatball fans exploded instantly, crushing those who were ready to see Shi Sheng's joke.

Look, even if they don’t add the V, they are still awesome. The sponsor of our little meatball must be like this.

Fang Liqiu V: Sir, please support me!//@江夜: Good night, Mr. Lu Qingyun

Su Yixiu V: The sponsor please pay me your salary //@江夜: Good night the sponsor @鲁清云

These two retweets immediately stirred up waves.

Fang Liqiu also has a huge number of fans. His goddess even openly asked for support on Weibo. Although you are a bit off-putting, goddess, can you please be reserved?

And that Su Yixiu, isn't that the BOSS of Youjian Entertainment?He is also asking for salary. Doesn’t that mean this is BOSS’s BOSS?Oh my god, what happened to this world.

Who is that Lu Qingyun? Come and do some popular science!!

Some people want to popularize science, but they can't find it at all. It's just a name, a vague profile, and not even a phone number. How can they check it?

Even if it can be found, it will not be found out in a short time.

So some people started talking, thinking that this was self-directed and self-acted, and those watch lists must have been edited.

As soon as this statement came out, some people refuted it. Just create a follow list full of big Vs!

The war was about to break out, but there was no movement from Lu Qingyun's side. Some technical geeks found out that the last login time of that account was the time when the only Weibo post was posted, and he never logged in again.

Everyone was dumbfounded.

Where is the agreed funder?

Just gone?

Shi Sheng's side was noisy, and Xia Xuan's side didn't stop either, because the previous studio said it would be continued, and many people were waiting for the next information.

Shortly after Shi Sheng's Weibo was posted, the studio also updated.

The content of this update is quite special. It is a group photo. The people in the photo are a group of young and beautiful college students. The background is a domestic university. Xia Xuan stands in the middle, looking cute, cute and energetic.

This looks like an ordinary group photo, nothing out of the ordinary.
